title: M6A RNA Methylation-Mediated TUG1 Stability Maintains Mitochondrial Homeostasis during Kidney Aging by Epigenetically Regulating PGC1-alpha Expression.
authors: Zhu, Yonghong; Yang, Bowen; Chen, Suyun; Chen, Guanqing; Zeng, Xiaobian; Min, Hui; Xu, Li
one_liner_zh: 该文研究m6A修饰调控lncRNA TUG1稳定性并通过表观遗传调控PGC1-alpha影响肾脏衰老，虽涉及RNA-蛋白互作，但核心是RNA表观修饰与线粒体稳态，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，且无AI/物理模拟建模方法。
abstract: Background: Aging is a significant risk factor for the increased incidence of acute kidney injury and chronic kidney disease, posing significant challenges to global public health. The role of N6-methyladenosine (m6A) in the development of chronic kidney disease has been reported, but the regulatory mechanism of m6A in kidney aging remains unclear. Results: In this study, we identified a long noncoding RNA (lncRNA), called taurine up-regulated 1 (TUG1), which exhibited a significantly decreased level of m6A modification in human aged kidney through the m6A-lncRNA epitranscriptome microarray. Bioinformatics analysis and machine learning predicted that TUG1 had potentially strong interaction with PGC1-alpha. RNA immunoprecipitation and chromatin immunoprecipitation analysis showed that TUG1 promoted proliferator-activated receptor gamma coactivator-1alpha (PGC1-alpha) expression by directly interacting with its TUG-1 binding element region, thereby impacting mitochondrial quality control (MQC), cellular senescence, and renal fibrosis. Silencing the RNA m6A methylase methyltransferase 14 (METTL14) or the reader protein insulin-like growth factor 2 mRNA-binding proteins (IGF2BP2) resulted in the weakened stability of lncRNA TUG1, contributing to an imbalance in MQC. Conclusion: Our study demonstrated that the m6A modification and stability of TUG1 were mediated by METTL14 in an IGF2BP2-dependent manner, and modulate the mitochondrial homeostasis in kidney aging by direct targeting PGC-1alpha. These findings provide a new perspective on potential therapeutic targets for kidney aging. Antioxid. Redox Signal. 41, 993-1013.
abstract_zh: 背景：衰老是急性肾损伤和慢性肾脏病发病率增加的重要危险因素，对全球公共卫生构成重大挑战。N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）在慢性肾脏病发展中的作用已有报道，但m6A在肾脏衰老中的调控机制仍不清楚。结果：在本研究中，我们通过m6A-lncRNA表观转录组微阵列鉴定了一种长链非编码RNA（lncRNA），称为牛磺酸上调基因1（TUG1），其在人类衰老肾脏中表现出显著降低的m6A修饰水平。生物信息学分析和机器学习预测TUG1与PGC1-alpha可能具有强相互作用。RNA免疫沉淀和染色质免疫沉淀分析显示，TUG1通过直接与其TUG-1结合元件区域相互作用，促进过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ共激活因子-1alpha（PGC1-alpha）表达，从而影响线粒体质量控制（MQC）、细胞衰老和肾纤维化。沉默RNA m6A甲基化酶甲基转移酶14（METTL14）或阅读蛋白胰岛素样生长因子2 mRNA结合蛋白（IGF2BP2）导致lncRNA TUG1稳定性减弱，促成MQC失衡。结论：我们的研究表明，TUG1的m6A修饰和稳定性由METTL14以IGF2BP2依赖性方式介导，并通过直接靶向PGC-1alpha调节肾脏衰老中的线粒体稳态。这些发现为肾脏衰老的潜在治疗靶点提供了新视角。抗氧化与氧化还原信号 41, 993-1013。
